verdict.rationale: The axis applies to an incorporation and registered-agent service, but the evidence pack has no first-party documentation of renewal charges or of cancellation or transfer-out terms. The docs mention a registered agent only as a compliance feature, without its renewal pricing or how to change agents when leaving. Community comments mention scattered costs ($500 setup, ~$300–$800/yr), but these are user anecdotes, not documented terms, and none address leaving the service without stranding the entity.
